cc:Work.dc:title: device-parallel-control
cc:Work.dc:description: Original projected schematics of multichannel MZI drive with photodetector feedback and MEMS array drive with camera feedback. Timing sketches distinguish serial, grouped, parallel and dependent execution. No optical atomicity or product performance is implied.
